item.text: I’ll validate the requested η kinematics, then generate the scan inputs and a machine-readable outcome record beside them.
The endpoints are singular for EXCLURAD. I’m applying its validated pole convention, replacing −1 and +1 with −0.999 and +0.999; the three interior points are already valid.
